CustomField.description: The program's badge and certificate links, as JSON — marketing data that changes when branding changes: {"digitalBadgePageUrl": "https://my.garp.org/DigitalBadgeFRM", "certificateDownloadPath": "/SCRCertificate", "partBadges": {"I": {"imageUrl": "...", "pageUrl": "..."}, "II": {...}}}. Every URL is stored WITHOUT the "?id=<contact>" the pages take — GARP_Portal_ProgramDetailService appends the signed-in member, so no row can be edited into pointing at somebody else's badge. partBadges is keyed by exam part ("I", "II") and supplies the per-part badge shown with a passing result. Leave blank to use the service's hard-coded fallback. Parsed strictly and independently of Config__c: a broken value here degrades only the credential links, with a named warning on the response.
CustomField.label: Credentials
